FILTRATION / SYSTEM NOTES
THE DETAILS

Water with a purpose.

Define the concern

Taste, odor and a particular contaminant are different concerns. Appropriate water information or testing helps selection.

Choose the location

Point-of-use systems serve a tap; whole-property treatment acts on the incoming supply. Confirm suitability and scope offered.

Match the treatment

Different technologies address different concerns. No system should be assumed to remove every contaminant.

Maintain performance

Include cartridge access, specified maintenance and ongoing service costs in your decision.

MATCH THE TREATMENT TO THE CONCERN

Sediment filtration targets suspended particles, subject to the system’s specified particle rating.

Examples only, not a promised system configuration.
